description: Standalone SPCF 2.0 classifier with generic taxonomy and fictional e-commerce examples only.
description_ru: Самостоятельный классификатор SPCF 2.0 с универсальной таксономией и только вымышленными примерами из e-commerce.
notes: No real project records, organizations, customers, project paths, or source registry facets are included.
The taxonomy is independent of the fictional examples.
L1-L4 classify project purpose, not technology stack.
Technology patterns are an independent catalog, not a classification level.
The e-commerce terms added in this export are generic taxonomy entries.
